test_torch_version_parsing: test the torch_version function parses version strings like 1.9.0 into tuples
test_torch_version_bad_format: test the torch_version function returns an empty tuple for bad format strings
test_torch_version_empty_string: test the torch_version function returns an empty tuple for empty string input
test_torch_version_git_suffix: test the torch_version function strips git suffixes like 1.10.0a0+gitbc6fc3e
test_torch_version_cu_suffix: test the torch_version function strips cuda suffixes like 1.7.0+cu102
